checks: Search page and shared navigation render in a real browser
Keyboard skip link focuses the main content
Example search returns the real Civic catalogue identity
Vehicle profile shows the verified 4 recall, 885 complaint and 2 investigation counts
Full official recall detail loads inside the profile
Complaint narrative and incident details render without raw JSON
Complaint pagination changes the displayed records
Official investigation detail and snapshot-status labels load in the profile
Anonymous save preserves the selected vehicle through sign-in
Mismatched registration passwords are rejected before submission
Registration creates a normal account and returns to the selected vehicle using real session cookies
Saving a vehicle succeeds with the real CSRF/session flow
Stored nickname markup is displayed as literal text without inserting an image or executing script
Nickname edit persists across a full page reload
Cancelling removal keeps the saved record
Credentials and tokens are not stored in browser web storage
Signed-out saved page exposes no personal records
Returning through browser history after logout does not reveal the old saved list
A second account sees its own empty saved list

Owner login restores its saved record and rejects an external return URL
Return-path validation rejects external, script and authentication-loop destinations

Vehicle profile fits the mobile viewport
Saved-vehicle forms and actions fit the mobile viewport

Incorrect credentials produce a readable error and allow retry
Search connection errors clear loading state and leave a usable retry
Search succeeds after the connection is restored
Unmatched filters show an empty result instead of stale vehicle cards
No uncaught browser JavaScript exceptions occurred
